bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money to the Clemency Review Commission.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$375,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Clemency Review Commission to increase the commission's capacity to process clemency petitions. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money to the Clemency Review Commission.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$375,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Clemency Review Commission to increase the commission's capacity to process clemency petitions.
additions: $375,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Clemency Review Commission to increase the commission's capacity to process clemency petitions.
